description: Signed proof report for an agent: Proof Score per category, record count, settled value, buyer diversity. PAID via x402 v2 (exact USDC on Base). Call without payment_signature to receive the payment requirements (no charge); call again with payment_signature = the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for one of those accepts. Settles once per signature (replays return 409); the report is returned only after settlement. Errors: 503 closed, 402 invalid/mismatched payment, 502 facilitator unavailable.
